# TESIGN

> TESIGN Radar presents AI-selected daily tools and rising and all-time rankings, under the owner’s delegation. Stars, increases, cross-source signals, updates and licences are the evidence. AI chooses the lists under the owner’s delegation. No human review is running in September 2026. Total stars, increases, cross-source signals, last updates and licences are shown as evidence. Run by tesign, a one-person studio. No ads, paid placement, accounts or payments.

## Start here

- [Today](https://tesign.com/en/): the finite daily selection (10 items; see /en/about/ for how items are chosen)
- [About](https://tesign.com/en/about/): what TESIGN Radar is and how selection works
- [FAQ](https://tesign.com/en/faq/)
- [Explore](https://tesign.com/en/explore/): every kept product with categories, sources and signals
- [한국어](https://tesign.com/): Korean edition (same content)

## Products (English)

- [oauthcli](https://tesign.com/en/item/oauthcli/): Checks what an OAuth or OIDC server supports and audits it against RFCs.
- [proton-cli](https://tesign.com/en/item/proton-cli/): Runs Proton Mail, Drive, Calendar, Pass and Contacts from the terminal.
- [Birdview](https://tesign.com/en/item/birdview/): Maps which modules an agent will touch before it edits a line.
- [Design Studio AI](https://tesign.com/en/item/design-studio-ai/): Lets people and agents edit the same web, slide, 3D and video designs.
- [PDF Pocket Tools](https://tesign.com/en/item/pdf-pocket-tools/): Merges, splits, rotates and reorders PDFs from one offline HTML file.
- [Programming Museum](https://tesign.com/en/item/museum-of-source-code/): Hangs real, runnable source code in frames you walk past room by room.
- [roamux](https://tesign.com/en/item/roamux/): Lets you watch and steer coding agents on your own machine from a phone.
- [pdfcn](https://tesign.com/en/item/pdfcn/): Builds invoice and report PDFs from React components you paste in.
- [DLSS 5 Swapper](https://tesign.com/en/item/dlss5-swapper/): Scans your game library and installs or restores DLSS 5 per game.
- [Amagine3D](https://tesign.com/en/item/amagine3d/): Designs printable hardware enclosures from a description and dimensions.
- [Viserys](https://tesign.com/en/item/viserys-agent/): Gives a coding agent one fixed process from define to ship, as skills.
- [BongoCat](https://tesign.com/en/item/bongocat/): Puts a Live2D desktop pet on screen that reacts to every key and click.
- [DuoFold for Android](https://tesign.com/en/item/duofold-android/): Makes a regular Android screen fold and shift as you tilt the phone.
- [Highball](https://tesign.com/en/item/highball/): Runs Windows games on Apple Silicon and tells you if yours will work.
- [Worlds Upon The Wind](https://tesign.com/en/item/wutw-public/): Releases a Steam deckbuilder's full source and art as public domain.
- [agent-memory](https://tesign.com/en/item/agent-memory/): Keeps what an agent learned as Markdown files it can search and reread.
- [Agency](https://tesign.com/en/item/agency/): Turns work a coding agent finds into cards you decide with one click.
- [Chat On Steroids](https://tesign.com/en/item/chat-on-steroids/): Lets a ChatGPT chat edit your files, run tests and use your desktop.
- [ARTEMIS](https://tesign.com/en/item/artemis/): Turns written instructions into automation on real Android phones.
- [Codex Astra Orchestrator + Luna Subagents](https://tesign.com/en/item/codex-astra-luna-orchestrator/): Installs a Codex setup where Astra orchestrates and Luna does the work.
- [humanizer](https://tesign.com/en/item/humanizer/): Strips the tells of AI-generated writing out of a draft.
- [caveman](https://tesign.com/en/item/caveman/): Cuts an agent's token use by stripping prompts down to bare words.
- [pi-desktop](https://tesign.com/en/item/pi-desktop/): Runs a local-first coding agent as a desktop app with plugins.
- [DeskComm CRM](https://tesign.com/en/item/deskcommcrm/): Runs a self-hosted CRM with built-in AI agents and WhatsApp chat.
- [OpenDisplay](https://tesign.com/en/item/opendisplay/): Turns an iPhone or iPad into a real second monitor for a Mac.
- [SoL-Pi](https://tesign.com/en/item/sol-pi/): Scales automated research loops that tune agent harnesses.
- [YuE2](https://tesign.com/en/item/yue/): Generates music, makes zero-shot covers and edits parts of a track.
- [quickgui](https://tesign.com/en/item/quickgui/): Renders desktop interfaces on the GPU without a webview.
- [Taste-Skill](https://tesign.com/en/item/taste-skill/): Stops a coding agent from producing the same generic-looking result.
- [diagram-design](https://tesign.com/en/item/diagram-design/): Draws 38 editorial diagram types as self-contained HTML and SVG.
- [Headroom](https://tesign.com/en/item/headroom/): Compresses tool output, logs and files before they reach the model.
- [OpenResearch](https://tesign.com/en/item/openresearch/): Runs several research agents in parallel on any model you choose.
- [open-code-review](https://tesign.com/en/item/open-code-review/): Reviews code line by line with fixed rule pipelines plus an LLM agent.
- [ecc](https://tesign.com/en/item/ecc/): Adds skills, memory and security rules to a coding agent harness.
- [Hermes Agent](https://tesign.com/en/item/hermes-agent/): Runs an agent meant to grow with the person using it.
- [OpenMontage](https://tesign.com/en/item/openmontage/): Turns a coding assistant into a full video production pipeline.
- [Worktrunk](https://tesign.com/en/item/worktrunk/): Manages Git worktrees for running several coding agents in parallel.
- [ponytail](https://tesign.com/en/item/ponytail/): Makes a coding agent ask whether the code needs writing at all.
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://tesign.com/en/item/deepseek-harness/): Builds an agent harness where every capability is a plugin.
- [tokentab](https://tesign.com/en/item/tokentab/): Reads agent session logs and works out cost by model, project and day.
- [colibri](https://tesign.com/en/item/colibri/): Runs frontier MoE models on hardware you already own.
- [archify](https://tesign.com/en/item/archify/): Exports architecture and data-flow diagrams as self-contained HTML.
- [Orca](https://tesign.com/en/item/orca/): Runs a fleet of coding agents in parallel from one place.
- [Recordly](https://tesign.com/en/item/recordly/): Turns a screen recording into a polished demo video without editing.
- [gods-eye-view](https://tesign.com/en/item/gods-eye-view/): Puts real satellite and flight tracks on a 3D globe in your browser.
- [VoiceStudio](https://tesign.com/en/item/voicestudio/): Clones voices, dubs video and transcribes audio on your own machine.
